string.text: World faction: %s. The host chose it when creating the game
The faction is set by the world and cannot be changed here.
The host %s made a new character for you (%s). Pick starting gear: the faction kit is free, the rest costs points (the host's economy sets them).
The host %s makes your character (%s) when you press Done. Pick starting gear: the faction kit is free, the rest costs points (the host's economy sets them). Then you enter the host's world.
Hardcore: your character is gone, and the new one starts with nothing - no kit, no money (the host has coop_hardcore_new_kit off). It joins the world's faction.
